results.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Kneel upright on both knees with your knees hip width apart and hold one dumbbell with both hands low beside one hip.
Rotate your torso and lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body until it is above the opposite shoulder, keeping your arms slightly bent.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your hips facing forward and your core engaged.
Reverse the movement and lower the dumbbell along the same diagonal path, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Rotate through your torso while keeping your hips stable and facing forward.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows without pulling the dumbbell with your arms alone.
Avoid leaning backward as the dumbbell reaches the top position.
Exhale as you lift and rotate the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell horizontally above your head with both hands, keeping your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and slowly bend your torso to one side while keeping your hips still and your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly at a comfortable range while keeping the dumbbell steady overhead.
Contract your obliques to return to the upright position with control, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine without leaning forward, leaning backward, or twisting.
Keep the dumbbell aligned above your head as your torso bends sideways.
Bend only as far as you can while maintaining balance and control.
Inhale as you bend to the side and exhale as you return upright.
results.description: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Overhead Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in both hands, extending your arms straight overhead with your palms facing each other.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the floor into a sitting position, keeping the dumbbell directly overhead.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position, maintaining control and keeping the dumbbell overhead.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the dumbbell remains directly overhead and in line with your shoulders during the entire movement.
Avoid using momentum; focus on a controlled and steady motion.
Start with a lighter weight to ensure proper form and avoid strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Overhead Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist With Legs Floor Off
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet lifted slightly off the floor, balancing on your glutes. Hold a dumbbell with both hands at chest level, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lean back slightly to form a V-shape with your torso and thighs, maintaining a straight spine.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell beside your right hip while keeping your legs stable together.
Return to the center, then rotate your torso to the left, bringing the dumbbell beside your left hip. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your legs stable and together to maintain balance.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Russian Twist With Legs Floor Off is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand with your arm fully extended by your side. Place your left hand behind your head.
Slowly bend to your right side at the waist, lowering the dumbbell towards the floor.
Bend as far as comfortably possible, feeling a stretch in your left oblique muscles.
Return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left side.
tips: Avoid using momentum; focus on a slow and controlled movement.
Exhale as you bend to the side and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Keep your head and neck in a neutral position, facing forward.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your feet stacked. Place your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell securely against your top hip.
Press your forearm into the floor and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Slowly lower your hips toward the floor while keeping your shoulders and hips stacked.
Contract the side of your core to raise your hips back to the starting position, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder.
Lower your hips without allowing them to rotate forward or backward.
Raise your hips until your body forms a straight line without overextending.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you raise them.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Plank With Rear Fly
instructions: Begin by positioning yourself in a side plank on your right side, with your right elbow directly under your shoulder and both feet on the floor shoulder-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand, with your arm extended straight out in front of your chest.
Engage your core to lift your hips off the floor, creating a straight line from your head to your feet. Maintain this plank position throughout the exercise.
Slowly raise the dumbbell in a wide arc motion outwards, lifting your arm until it is just higher than parallel to the floor, while slightly rotating your torso to the left.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on a slow and controlled movement to effectively engage the shoulder and upper back muscles.
Avoid letting your hips sag; keep your body in a straight line.
Start with a lighter weight to ensure proper form before progressing to heavier dumbbells.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Plank With Rear Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Starfish Crunch
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your arms and legs extended in a starfish position. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and keep the left hand firm on the floor.
Engage your core and lift your left leg and right arm simultaneously, aiming to touch the dumbbell to your left foot.
Reach as high as possible, squeezing your abdominal muscles at the top of the movement.

Lower your arm and leg back to the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to holding the dumbbell in your left hand and raising your right leg.
tips: Ensure your movements are slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
Keep your non-working arm and leg extended on the floor for balance.
Focus on using your abs to lift your arm and leg, not your neck or shoulders.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Arm Starfish Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders, Chest.

results.name: Dumbbell Starfish Crunch Alternating
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your arms and legs extended out in a starfish position, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Simultaneously lift your right arm and left leg towards each other, crunching your torso and bringing the dumbbell towards your left foot.
Lower back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the exercise in a controlled manner to maximize muscle engagement.
Avoid using momentum to lift your limbs; focus on the contraction of your core muscles.
Exhale as you lift your arm and leg, and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Dumbbell Starfish Crunch Alternating is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Dumbbell Straight Arm Crunch
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell with both hands extended straight above your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper back off the floor, raising the dumbbell towards the ceiling as high as possible, while keeping your arms straight.
Lower your upper back, back to the floor with control, maintaining the arms extended above your chest. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms straight and avoid bending your elbows during the movement.
Focus on reaching the dumbbell straight up rather than forward.
Exhale as you crunch up and inhale as you lower down.
results.description: Dumbbell Straight Arm Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.
